title: QFN/SON voiding: reflow and via design
terms: solder void missing solder low density reflow flux 空洞 孔洞 焊料缺失 低密度 回流

text.en: TI describes how reflow flux activity and thermal-via treatment can affect QFN/SON voiding. This is background for a candidate explanation, not proof of the cause in this synthetic sample.
text.zh: TI 指出，回流过程中的助焊剂活性和散热过孔处理会影响 QFN/SON 空洞。这只能提供候选解释，不能证明本合成样本的制造根因。

check.en: If applicable to the actual package, review the paste supplier's reflow profile and via design; compare adjacent slices before confirming a void.
check.zh: 若实际封装适用，检查焊膏供应商的回流曲线和过孔设计，并结合相邻切片复核空洞。

scope: QFN/SON assembly guidance; applicability to other package geometries requires review

title: QFN/SON solder bridging and land geometry
terms: solder bridge excess solder short spacing 焊桥 桥连 短路 焊料多余

text.en: TI relates solder-bridge prevention to pad geometry and clearance. Excess-solder differences are a screening signature; imaging errors can also produce them.
text.zh: TI 将焊桥预防与焊盘几何及间距联系起来。多余焊料差异属于筛查信号，成像误差也可能产生这种信号。

check.en: Review the actual land pattern and confirm connectivity in the reconstructed region. Do not import a package-specific acceptance limit into this demo.
check.zh: 检查实际焊盘布局并复核重建区域的连通性，不把特定封装的验收限值直接套用到本演示。

scope: QFN/SON geometry guidance; no universal pass/fail rule

title: Measured boundary false positives in the synthetic CT baseline
terms: artifact false positive threshold partial volume Hann boundary void artefact 伪影 误报 边界 阈值 空洞

text.en: The archived slice-wise experiment shows boundary misclassification after Hann FBP and fixed thresholding, including missing-solder predictions on clean slices. Candidate differences are not confirmed physical defects.
text.zh: 已归档的逐层实验显示，Hann FBP 与固定阈值分割会导致边界误分，包括在无缺陷层中预测出焊料缺失。候选差异不等于已确认的物理缺陷。

check.en: Inspect grayscale, reference alignment and neighboring slices together; validate any revised segmentation on independent samples.
check.zh: 同时检查灰度图、参考体对齐情况和相邻切片；改进分割后，用独立样本验证。

locator: Measured result and CUDA per-signature evaluation
scope: Project synthetic baseline; not a general scanner calibration

title: Slice-wise 3D geometry and measurements
terms: 3d volume slice reconstruction dimension depth geometry 体积 三维 切片 深度 重建

text.en: The connected demo reconstructs each parallel-beam detector row independently, then segments the stack and applies 3D reference comparison. It assumes aligned coordinates, isotropic voxels and no mixing between depths. It is not cone-beam CT.
text.zh: 贯通演示对每个平行束探测器行独立重建，再对堆叠体分割并做三维参考比较。它假定坐标对齐、各向同性体素且不同深度之间不混合；当前并非锥束 CT。

check.en: Confirm axis order, spacing and acquisition geometry before applying this workflow to another dataset.
check.zh: 用于其他数据前，确认轴顺序、体素间距和采集几何。

title: A slice measures area, not defect volume
terms: 2d area volume ratio percentage slice 二维 面积 体积 占比 百分比 切片

text.en: Single-slice inspection reports pixel counts and area. A volumetric void fraction needs a segmented 3D region and an explicitly defined denominator; neither can be inferred from one slice or a component identifier.
text.zh: 单切片检测报告像素数和面积。空洞体积占比需要三维分割区域及明确的分母，不能由一张切片或一个连通域编号推断。

check.en: Request 3D data and an identified joint region for a joint-level volume fraction. Keep pixel-level evaluation scores separate from defect fractions.
check.zh: 计算单焊点体积占比时，需要三维数据及已识别的焊点区域；评价指标不能当作缺陷占比。

title: Copper differences require independent confirmation
terms: copper open missing copper excess residue bridge 铜 开路 铜缺失 残留

text.en: The project assigns copper-difference signatures by comparing material labels. These labels do not measure electrical continuity or establish a plating or etching cause.
text.zh: 项目通过比较材料标签给出铜差异信号。这些标签并未测量电气连续性，也不能确认电镀或蚀刻根因。

check.en: Review reconstruction and segmentation, then use continuity tests or process records when a physical cause must be established.
check.zh: 先复核重建和分割；需要确认物理原因时，再结合导通测试或工艺记录。

scope: Project screening logic, not externally validated causal evidence

title: Evidence limits and root-cause hypotheses
terms: cause process evidence diagnosis confidence severity defect inspection 根因 原因 证据 严重 程度 检测 芯片 缺陷

text.en: Differences and rule-based severity are screening results. No process measurements or calibrated causal probabilities are supplied. An absence of detected differences does not establish a defect-free part.
text.zh: 差异及规则严重程度属于筛查结果。目前没有提供工艺测量或校准后的因果概率；未检出差异也不能证明器件无缺陷。

check.en: Obtain process records, independent inspection and applicable acceptance criteria before making a manufacturing disposition.
check.zh: 作制造处置前，需要工艺记录、独立检测和适用的验收标准。

locator: Scope and limitations of the completed synthetic integration
scope: Project limitations; no industrial acceptance certification
